Mr. Suyash Pant, Standing Counsel for the 
State of Uttarakhand.
Mr. Sanjay Kumar, Advocate for the private

After arguing for some time, since the 
petitioner is claiming his status as to be that of a 
Shreni 1 Kashtakar, he is directed to place on 
record the relevant khatauni of the fasli year, in 
which for the first time he was recorded as Shreni I 
Kashtakar, by a competent judicial order passed by 
the revenue authority, the same was directed to be 
recorded and his entries were converted to be 
recorded in Shreni I Ka. He may file it within a 
period of two weeks.
List this writ petition after two weeks.

Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. P.C. Maulekhi, Advocate, for the 
petitioner.
Mr. Narayan Dutt, Brief Holder, for the 
State.
Mr. Sanjay Kumar, Advocate, for 
respondent No. 3.
In compliance of the previous orders 
passed by this Court on 17.12.2019, 12.03.2020 
and 09.09.2021, the petitioner has filed a 
supplementary affidavit through IA/9875/2021, 
bringing on record the order passed by the 
Assistant Collector, 1st Class on 28.05.2007, in 
a proceedings, which was held by way of a 
Revenue Case No. 22/26, Chhote Vs. State in 
a proceeding which was conducted under 
Section 131(B) of the U.P.Z.A. & L.R. Act.
Based on the said decision, the petitioner’s 
name is shown to have been recorded in 
khatauni pertaining to 1409 to 1414 fasli.
The learned counsel for the respondent 
prays for and is granted two weeks’ time to file 
his objection to the supplementary affidavit.
List this writ petition as soon as the 
supplementary counter affidavit is filed by the 
respondent.
(Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
 16.12.2021 Mahinder/

WPMS No.135 of 2011
Hon’ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J. 
1. Mr. P. C. Maulekhi, learned counsel 
appears for the petitioner. 
2. Mr. M.S.Bisht, learned Brief Holder 
for the State/respondent nos. 1 to 3.
3. Mr. Sanjay Kumar, learned counsel 
for the respondent no. 4. 
4. A Substitution Application No. IA 
No. 9877 of 2023) along with Application 
for Condonation of Delay ( IA No. 9879 of 
2023) is moved for substituting the legal 
heirs of the sole petitioner. An 
application for setting aside the 
abatement (IA No. 9878 of 2023) is also 
moved. 
5. Counsel for the respondents has no 
objection on the Substitution 
Application. There is delay of 164 days in 
moving the Substitution Application and 
since the respondents have no objection 
therefore, the delay is condoned. After 
taking into consideration that the sole 
petitioner of the instant petition died and 
the Substitution Application has been 
moved for substituting his legal heirs, as 
such, the Substitution Application is 
allowed.  6. Let the necessary amendment be 
made in the memo of parties and 
amended memo of parties be filed within 
a week. 
7. List this matter after three weeks. 
8. Interim order, if any, is extended till 
the next date of listing. 
 (Rakesh Thapliyal, J.) 
 07.08.2023
Kaushal
